name: Divergences of Darkness Rework
summary: Divergences of Darkness Rework is a reworked version of the Divergences of Darkness created over the past few years (since 2017) with the mod going into full production in early 2020. This version of the mod has the intent to rework major regions. If Divergences of Darkness HPM is the "HPM" of Divergences then this mod is the "HFM" and does far deeper overhauls in terms of both lore and content.
